title_en: Apartment 2+1+2 at the Former Aviation Field!
description_en: We are selling a 2+1+2 apartment at the Former Aviation Field. The apartment has a total area of ​​119.63m2, of which 100.5m2 are internal. It is organized in a living room with kitchenette, 2 toilets, two bedrooms and a balcony with access from the living room and the matrimonial room. The apartment is located on the second floor and has a South-East orientation. For a visit to the property, contact us.
